title: Implement pull-style suck import from remote NNTP server
description:
Implement a CLI tool that connects to a remote NNTP server, fetches NEWNEWS since a given date/time for specified groups, retrieves each article via ARTICLE <msgid>, and feeds it into the local transit store-and-forward pipeline. Persists a cursor (last-fetched timestamp per group) so the tool can be run repeatedly. Artifact: transit/src/import/suck_pull.rs.

Acceptance:
- Connects to RFC 3977 NNTP server, issues NEWNEWS, retrieves articles
- Cursor persisted in SQLite; repeated runs only fetch articles newer than cursor
- --group flag filters to specific groups; --since flag overrides cursor
- Network errors cause retry with backoff (3 attempts); after that, log and continue to next article
- Test: run against a public NNTP test server or a local test server
